Q: Can't make insert with JPA when table Id has virtual column A:

Adding @jakarta.persistence.Transient on the field will indicate to JPA that the field must not be persisted.

Q: Unable to submit build to Cloud Build due to permissions error A:

https://stackoverflow.com/a/71630554/4840661 was correct. But enabling billing can be done via GUI:

  1. https://console.cloud.google.com/

  2. Choose project

  3. Navigation menu "Billing"

  4. Assign billing account.

Q: Submit a POST form in Cypress and navigate to the resulting page A:

If you'd like to simulate a form POST navigating to a new page, you can use cy.visit() to do this! Just change your request to visit and it should work:

cy.visit({
        url: "company-webpage-form-url.com",
        method: "POST",
        body: {
            first_name: "first_name",
            last_name: "last_name",
            company_name: "company_name",
            address1: "address1",
            address2: "address2",
            city: "city",
            state: "NY",
            zip: "13903",
            country: "US",
            phone_number: "607-555-5555",
            phone_ext: "555",
            fax_number: "fax_number",
            fax_ext: "fax_ext",
            email: "developer@company.com",
            email_2: "developer@company.com",
            user_data: "Continue"
        }
    });

Q: Getting permission denied to rls policy in Redshift A:

I had exactly this problem. It turns out I was missing SELECT permission for the control table for the RLS POLICY object. The following resolved the issue:

GRANT SELECT ON TABLE rls_demo.access_ctl TO RLS POLICY policy_ep_demo;

Q: SwiftUI parent onTapGesture intercepts taps from embedded AVPlayerViewController A:

In the question you mentioned:

Tested on iOS 26 works as it should.

When I tested on an iPhone 17 simulator with iOS 26.5, the tap gesture is only triggered when the text with blue background is tapped. So if this is how you want it to work then possible workarounds would be:

1. Attach the tap gesture to the Text, instead of to the VStack

The gesture should be applied after the blue background, so that it applies to the background too:

VStack {
    Text("Hello, world!")
        .background(Color.blue.frame(height: 100))
        .onTapGesture { // 👈 moved to here
            print("hello")
        }

    VideoPlayerView(data: .init(videoUrl: "https://www.pexels.com/download/video/5340598/"), design: .init())

}
.padding()

2. Add background to the VStack and attach the tap gesture to this instead

With this approach, you will need to apply .allowsHitTesting(false) to the Text (after the blue background), to allow gestures to pass through.

It would be possible to use Color.clear as the background behind the VStack - if doing it this way, apply a content shape to make it receptive to taps:

VStack {
    Text("Hello, world!")
        .background(Color.blue.frame(height: 100))
        .allowsHitTesting(false) // 👈 added

    VideoPlayerView(data: .init(videoUrl: "https://www.pexels.com/download/video/5340598/"), design: .init())

}
.padding()
.background { // 👈 added
    Color.clear
        .contentShape(.rect)
        .onTapGesture { // 👈 moved to here
            print("hello")
        }
}

When the tap gesture is applied in this way, the empty areas on the left and right of the blue rectangle are receptive to taps too.
